question.html:
A student investigates whether the Stefan–Boltzmann law, L = 4πσR2T4, applies to stars.

L = luminosity of the star, in W

σ = Stefan–Boltzmann constant

R = radius of the star, in m

T = surface temperature of the star, in K

To verify the law, they obtain values from databases and manipulate the data as shown.

a Complete the table with the missing values for Polaris B. [2]

b Explain how the gradient of the line of best fit relates to the Stefan–Boltzmann law. [2]

c Calculate the Stefan–Boltzmann constant obtained in this investigation. [2]

d Outline a conclusion for the investigation. [1]

e Suggest a possible improvement of the investigation, related to the range of the surface temperatures of the stars selected. [1]
